questions.question: What is pharmacology?
options: The study of drugs and their effects on the body
questions.explanation: Pharmacology is the study of drugs and their effects on living organisms.

questions.question: What is a drug?
options: A substance that affects body function
questions.explanation: A drug is any substance that affects the structure or function of the body when introduced.

questions.question: What is pharmacokinetics?
questions.explanation: Pharmacokinetics is the study of how the body absorbs, distributes, metabolizes, and eliminates drugs.

questions.question: What is pharmacodynamics?
questions.explanation: Pharmacodynamics is the study of how drugs affect the body and their mechanisms of action.

questions.question: What is a side effect?
options: An unintended effect of a drug
The main effect of a drug
questions.explanation: A side effect is an unintended effect of a drug that occurs in addition to the desired therapeutic effect.
